name: opensre
description: The open-source agent for CI/CD reliability.
one_liner: An AI agent that watches your CI pipeline, figures out why a build broke, and proposes a fix for a human to review, instead of you digging through logs.
buyer: An engineering manager at a mid-size startup losing developer hours every week to flaky or broken CI builds.
business_use_cases: A startup's engineering team self-hosts it to cut the hours engineers spend debugging broken CI runs every week.
A DevOps consultancy offers 'CI reliability as a service,' installing and tuning the agent for client pipelines.
A platform engineering team builds an internal 'CI doctor' product on top of it and charges other teams per repo onboarded.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a managed setup-and-tuning service for engineering teams.
Charge internal teams a per-repo fee for an internal 'CI doctor' platform built on it.

steal_this: Set it up free for one open-source project's CI this weekend as a case study, then pitch a paid 'managed CI reliability' service to startups.
